title: MSME size limits: micro, small or medium?
summary: How a business is grouped as micro, small or medium.

sections.heading: How MSMEs are grouped
paragraphs: Businesses are grouped as micro, small or medium. The group depends on investment and on turnover.
Both are looked at. The limits are in the box above.

sections.heading: Why your group matters
paragraphs: Some schemes and rules apply only to micro or small businesses. One example is the payment rule in our guide on MSME payments.

sections.heading: Find your group
paragraphs: Compare your investment and your turnover with the limits. If you are unsure, ask your CA.
